recommendation_summary: Rejects the initials column and naming convention as the approval control. Keeps the shared folder for drafts and adds a controlled release archive now. The archive preserves each exact approved version unaltered for seven years, records approval through a named reviewer's authenticated account with the time tied to that version, blocks self-approval and requires re-approval for every revision. The APPROVED column stays only as a status display. If these controls can't be in place before this week's delivery, the reply says to settle that with the customer before releasing.
note: The recommendation has every required LARGER capability, but none of the four labeled record lines appear.
